--- title: "Get started" jupyter: php --- ## Install the kernel juphyter is a development dependency of the project whose notebooks it runs. ```bash composer require --dev phpstats/juphyter vendor/bin/juphyter install ``` The command prints the four things the kernel is made of. ``` Installed the juphyter kernel "php" for PHP 8.5.10. kernel.json /Users/erik/Library/Jupyter/kernels/php/kernel.json python /opt/homebrew/bin/python3 (ipykernel 7.4.0) php /opt/homebrew/bin/php engine /path/to/vendor/phpstats/juphyter/bin/juphyter ``` The Python is the interpreter that owns the `jupyter` on `PATH`, because the kernel runs inside it. `--python` names a different one. The PHP is the binary that runs the cells, and `--php` names a different one, which is how several versions coexist: ```bash vendor/bin/juphyter install --name php83 --php /opt/homebrew/opt/php@8.3/bin/php vendor/bin/juphyter install --name php85 --php /opt/homebrew/opt/php@8.5/bin/php ``` `juphyter uninstall --name php83` removes a kernelspec juphyter wrote, and refuses to remove one it did not. ## A first cell A cell is PHP without an opening tag. The value of the last expression is the cell's result, and `echo` goes to the cell's output stream. ::: {#83327f73 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.php .cell-code} $primes = [2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13]; echo count($primes), " primes, summing to ", array_sum($primes), "\n"; array_sum($primes) / count($primes); ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` 6 primes, summing to 41 ``` ::: ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` 6.833333333333333 ``` ::: ::: State carries between cells, so the next cell sees what this one bound. ::: {#0f713fbe .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.php .cell-code} $primes[] = 17; $primes; ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ``` [2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13, 17] ``` ::: ::: ## Imports A `use` statement applies to the cells after it as well as to its own. The session accumulates them, so a notebook can put its imports in a first cell and use short class names from then on. ::: {#8be5bde2 .cell execution_count=3} ``` {.php .cell-code} use DateTimeImmutable; $released = new DateTimeImmutable('2026-11-20'); $released->format('F Y'); ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` Warning: The use statement with non-compound name 'DateTimeImmutable' has no effect in Cell 3, line 0 ``` ::: ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=3} ``` 'November 2026' ``` ::: ::: `namespace` is not supported in a cell, and a cell cannot redeclare a class or a function that another cell already declared. PHP has no way to undefine either, so a second run of a cell that declares one reports what it would have redeclared rather than failing in the middle. ## Errors A cell that throws reports the exception, its message, and the stack frames that raised it, with each stack frame naming the cell and the line rather than `eval()'d code`. ::: {#3a75ae3d .cell execution_count=4} ``` {.php .cell-code} $widths = ['narrow' => 4, 'wide' => 12]; $mean = fn (array $values) => array_sum($values) / count($values); $mean([]); ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` Warning: The use statement with non-compound name 'DateTimeImmutable' has no effect in Cell 4, line 0 ``` ::: ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-error} ``` DivisionByZeroError: Division by zero DivisionByZeroError: Division by zero in a closure at Cell 4, line 5 ``` ::: ::: Warnings, notices, and deprecations go to the cell's error stream and leave the cell running. ::: {#2d6d8c77 .cell execution_count=5} ``` {.php .cell-code} $widths = ['narrow' => 4, 'wide' => 12]; $widths['narrow'] + $widths['medium']; ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` Warning: The use statement with non-compound name 'DateTimeImmutable' has no effect in Cell 5, line 0 Warning: Undefined array key "medium" in Cell 5, line 3 ``` ::: ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=5} ``` 4 ``` ::: ::: ## Rich display A value is published in every representation the front end might draw. A phibble data frame comes with an HTML table and the tibble-style text phibble prints at a terminal, and a phiz plot comes with a Vega-Lite specification, an HTML embed, a static SVG when vl-convert is installed, and a one-line description. ::: {#7f63464b .cell execution_count=6} ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` Warning: The use statement with non-compound name 'DateTimeImmutable' has no effect in Cell 6, line -1 ``` ::: ::: ::: {#6810bc1f .cell execution_count=7} ``` {.php .cell-code} DataFrame::fromRows([ ['package' => 'phibble', 'purpose' => 'data frames', 'version' => 0.3], ['package' => 'phplyr', 'purpose' => 'dplyr verbs', 'version' => 0.3], ['package' => 'phiz', 'purpose' => 'plots', 'version' => 0.3], ]); ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` Warning: The use statement with non-compound name 'DateTimeImmutable' has no effect in Cell 7, line -1 ``` ::: ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=7} ```{=html}
A tibble: 3 × 3
package <chr>purpose <chr>version <dbl>
1phibbledata frames0.3
2phplyrdplyr verbs0.3
3phizplots0.3
``` ::: ::: Any class can opt in. A `toHtml(): string` method supplies the `text/html` representation, and a `toMimeBundle(): array` method supplies the whole bundle. ::: {#1d15abd6 .cell execution_count=8} ``` {.php .cell-code} final class Progress { public function __construct(private readonly int $done, private readonly int $total) {} public function toHtml(): string { return sprintf( ' %d of %d', $this->done, $this->total, $this->done, $this->total, ); } public function __toString(): string { return sprintf('%d of %d', $this->done, $this->total); } } new Progress(7, 9); ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` Warning: The use statement with non-compound name 'DateTimeImmutable' has no effect in Cell 8, line -1 ``` ::: ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=8} ```{=html} 7 of 9 ``` ::: ::: `Juphyter\display()` publishes a value part way through a cell, so one cell can show several data frames or plots. ::: {#c8176c15 .cell execution_count=9} ``` {.php .cell-code} Juphyter\display(new Progress(3, 9)); Juphyter\display(new Progress(9, 9)); ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` Warning: The use statement with non-compound name 'DateTimeImmutable' has no effect in Cell 9, line -1 ``` ::: ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display} ```{=html} 3 of 9 ``` ::: ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display} ```{=html} 9 of 9 ``` ::: ::: ## Where to go next [Quarto](quarto.qmd) covers rendering a `.qmd` to HTML, `ipynb`, and PDF. [JupyterLab](jupyter.qmd) covers the notebook interface and what it draws.
